state.task: Review this code from GrapiX row 2.16 for defects. Each process writes JSON Lines logs named <process>-<UTC start to the second>-<pid>-<part>.jsonl. At start, a sink opens its own file, then names (log.previous_unfinished) every earlier run of its process that is gone without log.stop and that no earlier start can have named, and lists in its log.start the runs still running. The engine catches Ctrl+C with the ctrlc crate and writes engine.stop then log.stop. Named limits, not defects: races at the same instant may repeat a naming; a wall clock stepped backwards can reorder runs; a window close is not orderly; the non-Windows lock path is not run on this machine.
